package main

// The null-before-the-value corpus (RB9-F6 TS port, step 3; found by a byte case that the new -g bases brought in: xpartition2/routing-history-unproven-g.json
// "message":null written before the "message" of a sequenced message). The generated UnmarshalJSON of Accumulate holds every union member as
// *encoding.JsonUnmarshalWith[T] whose Func is set only on the pointer the decoder starts with: encoding/json sets that pointer to nil on a null and allocates a
// FRESH one (Func nil) for the next value, and calling the nil Func panics, which Import recovers and reports as a value Accumulate's codec cannot decode.
// So a null written BEFORE the real value of a union member refuses the document, while the same null written after it (the objsweep corpus' dup-null-after)
// leaves the member empty. The sweeps so far wrote a wrongly typed value before the member and a null only after it, so the class was open.
//
// EVERY member of EVERY object path class of the bases (the first sweepK documents of each form that hold the class, the genesis-link documents first) is given:
//
//	dup-null-before        the member's key with the value null written just before it (the key as spelled)
//	dup-null-before-upper  the same with the key in upper case (encoding/json matches a key without regard to case): skipped for a key with an escape
//	null-between           the member, then the key with null, then the key with a copy of the member's value (value, null, value)
//	null-then-empty-list   (a list) the key with null, then the key with the empty list in the place of the member's value (null, [])
//	null-empty-list-then-value  (a list) the key with null, the key with the empty list, then the member (null, [], value)
//
// A case is a list of byte edits of the base file, judged as every byte corpus is; each shard is its own file, bytes-cases-nulldup-<i>.json.gz, consumed by
// test/s3-bytes-nulldup-<i+1>.test.ts.
//
//	XTS_SHARD=<i>/<n> ./xtsgen -fixtures $S3 -out <dir> nulldup      (XTS_COUNT=1 only counts)

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

func nullDupCases(doc []byte, n objNode) []objCase {
	if n.inArray || n.ms < 0 {
		return nil
	}
	key := string(doc[n.ms:n.vs]) // `"key" :` as spelled, with its colon and spacing
	val := string(doc[n.vs:n.ve])
	out := []objCase{{"dup-null-before", []ByteEdit{{n.ms, 0, ins(key + "null,")}}}}
	if !strings.Contains(key, `\`) && strings.ToUpper(key) != key {
		out = append(out, objCase{"dup-null-before-upper", []ByteEdit{{n.ms, 0, ins(strings.ToUpper(key) + "null,")}}})
	}
	out = append(out, objCase{"null-between", []ByteEdit{{n.ve, 0, ins("," + key + "null," + key + val)}}})
	if n.kind == 'a' { // a list: a *encoding.JsonUnmarshalListWith calls its Func for an element only, so an empty list after a null decodes
		out = append(out, objCase{"null-then-empty-list", []ByteEdit{{n.ms, 0, ins(key + "null,")}, {n.vs, n.ve - n.vs, ins("[]")}}})
		out = append(out, objCase{"null-empty-list-then-value", []ByteEdit{{n.ms, 0, ins(key + "null," + key + "[],")}}})
	}
	return out
}

func nullDupCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "Every member of every object path class of the bases (the first sweepK documents of each form holding the class; the genesis-link documents first), given a null before its value (the key as spelled and in upper case) and a null between two copies of its value: a null before the value of a union member refuses the document (encoding/json allocates a fresh *JsonUnmarshalWith whose Func is nil), a null after it leaves the member empty. Judged by VerifyPortable from the text."}
	gb, err := genesisBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ob, err := objBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	have := map[string]bool{}
	var bases []string
	for _, b := range append(append([]string(nil), gb...), ob...) {
		if !have[b] {
			have[b] = true
			bases = append(bases, b)
		}
	}
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStableCounting(raw, new(int), new(int))
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	shard, shards := 0, 1
	if v := os.Getenv("XTS_SHARD"); v != "" {
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(v, "%d/%d", &shard, &shards); err != nil || shards < 1 || shard < 0 || shard >= shards {
			return fmt.Errorf("XTS_SHARD %q: want i/n", v)
		}
	}
	use := map[string]int{}
	classes := map[string]bool{}
	byV := map[string]int{}
	seq := 0
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		form := "2.1"
		if objForm20.Match(docs[bi]) {
			form = "2.0"
		}
		w := &objWalker{b: docs[bi]}
		w.value(0, "", "", -1, false)
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, n := range w.out {
			if n.class == "" {
				n.class = "$root"
			}
			if seen[n.class] {
				continue
			}
			seen[n.class] = true
			k := form + "|" + n.class
			if use[k]++; use[k] > sweepK {
				continue
			}
			for _, c := range nullDupCases(docs[bi], n) {
				if seq++; (seq-1)%shards != shard {
					continue
				}
				classes[k] = true
				if os.Getenv("XTS_COUNT") != "" {
					continue
				}
				text := applyEdits(docs[bi], c.edits)
				lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
				ex, ok := judgeSweep(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
				if !ok {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s %s [%s] %s%s\n", bpath, n.class, c.name, lastPanic, lastFlaky)
					continue
				}
				byV[ex.V]++
				f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("nulldup:%s:%s:%s", bpath, n.class, c.name), Base: bi, Op: "nulldup " + c.name, Edits: c.edits, Expect: ex})
			}
		}
	}
	var names []string
	for k, v := range byV {
		names = append(names, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", k, v))
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "nulldup shard %d/%d: %d bases, %d path classes (form|class), %d cases in all, %d judged here (%s)\n", shard, shards, len(bases), len(classes), seq, len(f.Cases), strings.Join(names, " "))
	if os.Getenv("XTS_COUNT") != "" {
		return nil
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, fmt.Sprintf("bytes-cases-nulldup-%d.json.gz", shard)), mustJSON(f))
}
